entities.summary: Església de Sant Andreu d'Arinsal is a church located in Arinsal, La Massana Parish, Andorra. It is a heritage property registered in the Cultural Heritage of Andorra. It was built in the 17th century. The church has a 17th century altarpiece of the Virgin Mary and a 17th–18th century carving of Saint Andrew.
